preservation_semantics: Direct preservation means retaining an explicit distinguishable role/operation rather than hiding it inside X, K, a generic P, or an uninterpreted label. The contract does not claim absolute mathematical non-encodability.

F_dyn.formal_definition_summary: Keep Time/Config/succession; define target transition(x,x') iff there exists a P_in operation p with source transition(x,p,x').
F_dyn.interpretation: G_dyn remains a valid coarse dynamical view, but the projection is scientifically lossy on the frozen corpus.

F_pomdp_like.formal_definition_summary: Keep X as State, P_in as Action, K transition, O, generalized preorder Q and T; existentially forget which P_out query generated an O trace. Pi and C are absent.

forgotten_or_collapsed.item: P_in versus P_out as two first-class interface directions

scalar_reward_specialization_pressure.formal_view_note: The Lean comparator intentionally keeps generalized preorder Q and therefore does not itself impose scalar reward.
scalar_reward_specialization_pressure.if_Q_is_restricted_to_scalar_reward: Additional frozen Q semantics would require re-encoding or enrichment.

observation_orientation_pressure.note: The formal view keeps O but existentially forgets P_out identity; it does not repair epistemic O->latent-X relations or all incoming O directions.

representative_witnesses.pressure: O->X / O->O topology without clean outward rho

F_pomdp_like.interpretation: A POMDP-like view captures a large backbone but is not distinction-preserving unless enriched with structure that substantially reintroduces Pi, C, query identity/direction, generalized Q, and broader observation semantics.
